## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an existing issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks run and a minimal reproduction. Use synthetic data.

## Risks

Explain breaking changes, security/privacy impact and dependency/license changes.

- [ ] Build and tests pass locally.
- [ ] Regression tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implementation.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or third-party code without permission are included.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the project's MIT license.
